items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I met him. I met everybody.

ctx.x: And I seed a lot of people that were foolin' with that stuff, I seen how they act, you know. I say, "Ah, that ain't for me." Stand around half 'sleep some place, don't know what's goin' on. Not me. I can't dig that.
How about Charlie Parker? He...uh, you knew him, didn't you?
Yeah, I met him. I met everybody.
